name: Ahrefs
one_liner: Ahrefs offers a REST API (v3) for marketing and SEO data, accessible via API keys or OAuth2, with MCP support for AI assistants.
auth_notes: API key is passed as a bearer token in the Authorization header; OAuth2 authorizationCode flow is also available for MCP and Connect.
access_notes: API and MCP access is included on Lite and higher subscription plans (Lite $129/month, Standard $249/month, Advanced $449/month, Enterprise $1,499/month).

evidence.snippet: Ahrefs now has an official MCP server that connects directly to Claude and ChatGPT

If your plan already lists API and MCP access, the key comes from your own Ahrefs account rather than from a negotiation, so the sequence is simply to hold a qualifying subscription and then generate the token.

notes: The API requires a paid subscription; there is no free tier. OAuth2 is used for MCP and Connect, while the primary API uses a bearer token.
